mu_name_from: ZzzOpenData.cpp loads item group ITEM_ETC number i from Book{i+1:02}.bmd, so number 13 is Book14.bmd; MuMain's ZzzInfomation.cpp:435 has ITEM_SCROLL_OF_INFERNO teach AT_SKILL_INFERNO, and OpenMU's Version095d/Items/Scrolls.cs:32 names group 15 number 13 the Scroll of Inferno. 0.95d's and not 0.75's: 0.75 has no Inferno.
why_this_one: The user, 2026-10-02: 'now work on inferno', after Hellfire and Twister. The wizard's last ring spell in 0.95d, Hellfire's rule at a lower damage and a higher price (sim/skills.cpp).
mesh_note: No geometry of its own. Book01.bmd through Book19.bmd are byte-identical in MuMain's Data/Item -- Book14.bmd's md5 is Book01's, addf8a7d -- so this names the one the pipeline has built, as Book02 through Book16 do.

stats.note: A scroll's row, in the shape of Book01's, at 0.95d's numbers.
stats.from: openmu/src/Persistence/Initialization/Version095d/Items/Scrolls.cs:32, CreateScroll(13, 14, "Scroll of Inferno", 88, 0, 578, 265000); WebZen 1.00.93's item(Kor).txt row 15/13 agrees on the drop level 88 and the price 265000.
stats.classes_from: QualifiedCharacters.Add(DarkWizard) in CreateScroll (Version095d adds the Magic Gladiator, who is not in this game). Prize.ReadBy refuses the other two.

skill.note: What the scroll teaches, and nothing here reads it. See Book01, which carries the argument for recording it and the two rules attached to these numbers - the requirement is not scaled, and the value is the price outright.
skill.name: Inferno
skill.tells: A ring of fire bursts round him, striking every monster within four tiles.
skill.tells_from: The skill's own line in sim/skills.cpp, kept letter for letter so the scroll's tooltip and the skill's card say the same thing.
skill.energy_from: Version095d/SkillsInitializer.cs:59 and Scrolls.cs:32 both: 578. OpenMU's later FixItemRequirementsPlugIn writes 200 into the scroll's raw row, WebZen's figure, which its requirement formula scales; this project carries a scroll's requirement raw (docs/mu-scrolls-and-orbs.md SS4), so it takes the skill's own 578.
skill.level_from: Ours: about twice the scroll's drop level, in MU's own order (the user's audit of 2026-10-02: 'currently chars can get end game scroll and orbs pretty fast, remember we have 100% exp rate'). At kExperienceRate 100 a character who never leaves Lorencia reaches level 60 in about a hundred kills and 120 in about sixteen hundred, so MU's own gates -- energy alone on a scroll, the drop level on an orb -- fell within minutes. The energy (or other stat) MU asks is kept beside it.
